plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Sociology Major (BA) program page (poid=934). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The introduction states the major requires a minimum of ten courses, or 30 semester hours, and that fifteen semester hours must be taken at Salem, including SSCI 395, the senior capstone course. The recorded total (30) is the exact itemized sum: the five required core courses at 15 plus the five elective slots at the printed minimum of 3 hours each. Prerequisites recorded only where every named course is a fixed course in this plan: SOCI 201 requires SOCI 100; SSCI 255 requires SSCI 130. Disclosed, not recorded: SSCI 130's printed prerequisite is 'SOCI 100 or permission of instructor' (a one-of with a non-course alternative); SSCI 395's printed prerequisite is '90 hours of completed coursework' (not a course); the elective courses' prerequisites name courses outside this plan (see the elective slots). This plan is the plain Sociology major only; the separate Sociology with a concentration in Criminology major is not included.

courses.title: Sociology Elective
courses.choice_note: Select one additional elective course from the printed list: any SOCI course (3 hrs min.), CRST 150 Deviance (3 Hour(s)), CRST 160 Juvenile Delinquency (3 Hour(s)), or MATH 242 Nonparametric Statistical Methods (3 Hour(s)). The program requires five such electives, recorded as five slots at the printed minimum of 3 Hour(s) each. Because the printed list includes the open category 'any SOCI course', no closed option list is recorded. Disclosed prerequisites of the named courses, none of which is a fixed course in this plan: CRST 150 and CRST 160 each require CRST 100 or SOCI 270 or CRST 110; MATH 242 requires one of BIOL 205, BUAD 240, ECON 320, MATH 107 or MATH 132 -- MATH 132 has no course detail page and no search match in this catalog edition, as printed. A completion using an elective printed above 3 hours totals more than the recorded total, as printed.
